notes: The clause's two waws are counted against the ASV's one connective: the first takes and when as one rendering (rule 55), the second goes unrepresented because the ASV opens the apodosis bare (rule 14).
put themselves in array is a light verb with its complement, headed on array (rule 44); the reflexive realizes the verb's own participant and is not a supplied object.
Marginal notes (Or, the battle was spread; Hebrew array) read and set aside under rule 38.
